messages:
Olivia (People Ops): Hey @Anita — I saw your ticket about payroll after the July move. Did you submit the W-4/IT-2104 change for NY?
Anita (Employee): Hi! Yes I updated address in ADP on 2024-07-15 and uploaded NY withholding form. But my July 31 paycheck still shows CA state tax and no NY withholding. Ticket #4021
Tom (Payroll): @Olivia @Anita looking. Can you paste the paystub lines for state deductions? If not, I'll pull from payroll system.
Anita (Employee): pasted screenshot in ticket but here's relevant snippet:
```
Gross Pay: $8,500.00
Federal Tax: $1,530.00
CA State Tax: $0.00
NY State Tax: $0.00
Local (NYC) Tax: $0.00
Net Pay: $6,970.00
Notes: address on file: 123 West 14th St, NY
```
Tom (Payroll): Hmm shows both CA and NY zero — the system didn't apply withholding because residency change was flagged mid-month and auto-enrollment was off. I can run an off-cycle payroll to correct withholding, or adjust next paycheck. Which does Anita prefer?
Anita (Employee): I'd prefer off-cycle, worried about underpayment + penalties.
Miguel (Finance): +1 for off-cycle. We should also run employer tax withholding reconciliation (SUI/SDI) and remit adjustments for CA and NY. @Tom what's the expected gross deduction to collect?
Tom (Payroll): Rough calc: retroactive NY withholding for July ~ $420 and employer adjustments ~ $60. We'll run off-cycle for $420 withheld from gross, net check will be adjusted accordingly. Will need Anita's sign-off for taking extra from net or deducting from next pay. Anita?
Anita (Employee): Please do from net/issue small separate deduction. Don't want my next salary reduced.
Olivia (People Ops): We'll get Anita a clear summary and sign-off form. @Tom can you confirm timeline?
Tom (Payroll): Can do off-cycle payroll tomorrow morning (1748060322) if Anita signs the waiver today. I'll mark ticket and CC HR-bot.
HR-bot: Off-cycle payroll request created: OCR-7782. Scheduled: 2024-08-01 09:00 UTC. Please complete sign-off form: https://payroll.example.com/forms/ocr-7782
Anita (Employee): Signed the form. Thanks all.
Tom (Payroll): Done. Off-cycle ran; retro deductions applied. You'll see separate transaction labeled 'Retro NY Withholding' on bank. LMK if anything off. :thumbsup: 
Anita (Employee): I see it, thanks!! :relieved:
